That feels natural. I clicked **Reading** and the library narrowed to just the two I'd think of as reading — the focused-work piece and the "living with presence" one — while the pasta recipe dropped away. And I can see one of those carries both Work and Reading, so a single bookmark holding more than one tag is right; that's how I think about them. Having the tags sit as buttons right above the cards, and knowing a tag choice stacks on top of whatever I've typed in search, matches how I'd want to narrow things down.

You mentioned a second version to compare — go ahead and show me that one.
